applicabilityBasis.summary: XAUt represents undivided ownership of one fine troy ounce of physical gold on specified bars. Its reference value follows gold, rather than a fixed amount of national currency or a national-currency-denominated deposit under GENIUS sections 2(17) and 2(22).

genius.notes: XAUt represents ownership of physical gold and is classified as a non-payment token for the GENIUS tracker. The dated reserve report confirms TG Commodities, S.A. de C.V. as issuer. GENIUS section 2 defines monetary value by national currency or a currency-denominated deposit; this gold ownership claim has no fixed national-currency redemption obligation. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
